verdict.rationale: Lium documents root access, plus Docker-in-Docker, on every pod, and says users and agents can connect to pods and run remote commands via `lium exec`. That covers the root-level-control half of the story. However, no evidence explicitly mentions SSH access or registering your own SSH public keys. missing for 10: explicit SSH access documentation, bring-your-own SSH key registration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can SSH into my GPU instance with my own keys and get root-level control of the environment

citations.quote: root and Docker-in-Docker on every pod
An agent can do everything on Lium with no browser: sign up, fund, rent, connect and remove pods.
